name: bfe-request-policy-evaluation-plans
instr:
Let operators evaluate a synthetic HTTP request against BFE's currently loaded policy modules and inspect what would happen before forwarding traffic. The resulting plan must explain ordered module decisions and the aggregate live-processing disposition without causing operational side effects.

Evaluation follows effective callback and short-circuit semantics across token authentication, AI routing, AI rate limiting, external authentication, text access, and PB3 access, carrying simulated context between dependent decisions. Every enabled evaluator contributes exactly one module-specific applicable, non-applicable, or invalid outcome, and deterministic cases agree with live handlers on matched rules and disposition. Each outcome exposes the prospective live decision in full: token authentication reports credential validation and bound quota-plan information, external authentication reports the sanitized request and configured response interpretation, and text and PB3 access report request and session emission decisions with their native formatting and suppression mechanics. Evaluation never mutates caller-owned request state, counters, quotas, Redis capacity, routes, logs, or outbound transports. Each report observes one coherent configuration snapshot, remains isolated under repetition and concurrency, and serializes deterministically in evaluation order. Malformed input produces structured failure information without panics, proxy execution, or external-auth dialing. Exist
